items.title: The cocaine superhighway from Ecuador to Europe - the BBC reports on gangs and the police fightback
items.description: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.

items.title: Trump says Iran war talks taking place during lull in strikes
items.description: The US president says "there is a good chance that something could happen", as Iran denies direct talks are taking place.

items.title: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
items.description: The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights.

items.title: Zidane confirmed as France head coach
items.description: Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.

items.title: Ariana Grande sues hackers who leaked music and videos
items.description: The pop star is suing to discover the identity of hackers who obtained unreleased photos and songs.

items.title: A Japanese town wrestles with identity after protests over its first mosque
items.description: As Japan increasingly relies on foreign workers, it is also grappling with how to integrate new cultures and religions.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5bn to settle baby powder lawsuits
items.description: The proposed settlement aims to close a years-long legal battle over claims its talcs products cause cancer.

items.title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of 14-year-old
items.description: The star is accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were found in a Tesla registered to his address.

items.title: Number of suspects in fatal Seattle food festival shooting rises to three
items.description: One suspect is in custody, while a second is being sought and a third is thought to have died at the scene, court documents show.

items.title: Hong Kong activist allowed to stay in UK after deportation threat
items.description: Wu was detained for hours at London's Heathrow Airport last week and refused entry, he told the BBC.

items.title: Zoo staff rescue near-extinct snails from remote rock
items.description: Just 21 Madeiran land snails were found clinging to a rock on Portugal's Bugio Island, say conservationists.

items.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
items.description: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.
